Sandbox_EnableEntryActions_tooltip: Master switch for the whole mod: crowbar prying, screwdriver lockpicking and bolt cutters. Turn off to fully disable it.
Sandbox_EnablePrySystem_tooltip: Master switch for the crowbar. Allow prying locked doors, windows and garage doors open. The toggles below narrow it down by target.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleDoorPry_tooltip: Allow prying locked vehicle doors and hatches open with a crowbar.
Sandbox_EnableGarageDoorPry_tooltip: Allow crowbar prying on garage and roll-up doors.
Sandbox_EnableReinforcedDoorPry_tooltip: Allow prying reinforced/security doors (vault doors, etc). Requires the Strength level set below. Off by default.
Sandbox_ReinforcedDoorStrengthRequired_t: Minimum Strength level needed to attempt prying a reinforced door with a crowbar. Applies to the first forced entry only - a door already forced once stays accessible. Set to 0 to require no Strength at all.
Sandbox_PrySuccessMultiplier_tooltip: Scales crowbar success chance. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double, 0.5 = half.
Sandbox_PryNoiseMultiplier_tooltip: Scales the noise radius generated by prying. Higher values attract more zombies.
Sandbox_EnableScrewdriverLockpick_toolti: Master switch for the screwdriver. Allow quietly picking locked doors and vehicle doors. The toggles below narrow it down by target.
Sandbox_EnableVehicleDoorLockpick_toolti: Allow picking locked vehicle doors and hatches with a screwdriver.
Sandbox_EnableGarageDoorLockpick_tooltip: Allow screwdriver lockpicking on garage and roll-up doors.
Sandbox_EnableReinforcedDoorLockpick_too: Allow picking reinforced/security doors (vault doors, etc) with a screwdriver. Requires the Nimble level set below. Off by default, so security doors stay a late-game target.
Sandbox_ReinforcedDoorLockpickNimbleRequ: Minimum Nimble level needed to attempt picking a reinforced door with a screwdriver. Applies to the first forced entry only - a door already forced once stays accessible. Set to 0 to require no Nimble at all.
Sandbox_LockpickSuccessMultiplier_toolti: Scales screwdriver success chance. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double.
Sandbox_LockpickNoiseMultiplier_tooltip: Scales the (small) noise radius from lockpicking. Default 0.4 = very quiet.
Sandbox_EnableBoltCutter_tooltip: Master switch for bolt cutters. Allow cutting the lock off a locked door or gate. Louder than a screwdriver, more reliable than a crowbar. The toggles below narrow it down by target.
Sandbox_EnableGarageDoorBoltCut_tooltip: Allow cutting the lock off garage and roll-up doors with bolt cutters.
Sandbox_EnableReinforcedDoorBoltCut_tool: Allow bolt cutters on reinforced/security doors. Independent of the crowbar and screwdriver toggles above, and on by default: a chain and padlock give way to the tool even where muscle and patience wouldn't.
Sandbox_ReinforcedDoorBoltCutStrengthReq: Reinforced door bolt cutter Strength requirement

Minimum Strength level needed to cut a reinforced door open with bolt cutters. Applies to the first forced entry only. Default 0: the leverage is the tool's, not the survivor's - raise it if you want cutters gated too.
Sandbox_BoltCutSuccessMultiplier_tooltip: Scales bolt cutter success chance for both locks and fences. 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double.
Sandbox_BoltCutNoiseMultiplier_tooltip: Scales the noise radius from cutting locks and fences. Bolt cutters are the loudest of the three tools by default.
Sandbox_EnableFenceCutting_tooltip: Allow cutting a hole through wire-mesh and barbed-wire fence panels with bolt cutters. The panel is removed and its wire is salvaged.
Sandbox_FenceCutTimeMultiplier_tooltip: Scales how long cutting a fence panel takes. Higher values mean a longer, riskier job.
Sandbox_EnableFenceSalvage_tooltip: Drop the panel's wire (and barbed wire) at your feet after cutting through it. Turn off to make fence cutting purely a way in, with nothing to gain.
Sandbox_ActionTimeMultiplier_tooltip: Scales how long every entry action takes - prying, lockpicking and bolt cutting alike. Higher values mean longer, riskier jobs. Fence cutting scales this further with its own multiplier.
Sandbox_ToolWearOnFailMultiplier_tooltip: Scales condition loss on crowbars, screwdrivers and bolt cutters when an attempt fails. 0.0 = tools never wear out.
Sandbox_InjuryChance_tooltip: Chance of a minor hand injury when a crowbar or bolt cutter attempt fails. 0.0 = disabled, 1.0 = guaranteed.
Sandbox_InjuryDamage_tooltip: How much damage a failed attempt does to the hand when it injures you. 0 = no damage at all.
